fit_line: A Pune-based React and TypeScript developer with 3 years of full-stack experience, including a CRM and REST and CRM integrations, ready to join immediately.

screening_answers.question: How many years of React experience do you have?
screening_answers.answer: I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience, with React and TypeScript used across my recent projects: Safey Inventory (React 19, TanStack, shadcn/ui), contractor-ai-ops-dashboard and PageForge (Next.js, React 19).

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience integrating React apps with REST APIs and CRM systems.
screening_answers.answer: At the US-based medical-device company I built and maintained web apps and a CRM. In PageForge, engagement events flow to PostHog and HubSpot. In my portfolio backend, I send HMAC-signed CRM events and handle authentication, validation and error responses.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period?
screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in Sep 2026.

screening_answers.question: What are your salary expectations?
screening_answers.answer: I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more, and I am flexible on structure. What matters to me is the total package and the work.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience with testing and code quality?
screening_answers.answer: I wrote 10 end-to-end API tests for my portfolio backend and 9 for Orbital Surplus, and I use Git and GitHub Actions CI. I am comfortable extending that practice to unit and component tests and taking part in code reviews.

paragraphs: I am applying for the React Developer role at Systems Plus. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built and maintained web applications and a CRM. I am based in Pune and available immediately.

Your posting centres on React, JavaScript and TypeScript applications that connect to REST APIs and CRM systems. In Safey Inventory I built a React 19 operations tool with reusable shadcn/ui components. In PageForge, engagement flows to the HubSpot CRM, and my portfolio backend handles authentication, signed webhooks and 10 end-to-end API tests.

I enjoy making internal tools simple for the people who use them, with responsive, accessible interfaces. I have no contact center platform experience yet, but I learn integrations quickly. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your Contact Center Technology team.
